categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Modifies test fuzz utilities in src/test/fuzz/util/wallet.h and the wallet spend fuzz harness to optimize fuzzing execution throughput.
categories.rationale: Reusing a single FuzzedWallet across iterations yields an observed 4x to 6x speedup in the wallet fuzz harness. This provides a solid throughput improvement for fuzzing, though it does not affect standard CI runtime.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches src/wallet/wallet.cpp and wallet.h only to add a test-only state reset helper (ClearInMemoryTxStateForTest) supporting the fuzz harness.
categories.rationale: The PR changes no wallet behavior, database persistence, or user-facing interfaces, with wallet edits strictly serving fuzz testing infrastructure.
